meta.name: pi-planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会在你的项目根目录建 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文件当磁盘记忆:多步任务先写计划再动手,每完成一个阶段就更新进度、记录错误,做决定前重读计划。
howto.when: 当你要求拆解、规划多步项目或研究任务,或工作预计需要 5 次以上工具调用时接管;/clear 之后它会读取计划文件恢复上下文。

howto.what_en: Claude keeps task_plan.md, findings.md and progress.md in your project root as on-disk memory: it writes the plan before a multi-step task, updates progress and logs errors after each phase, and re-reads the plan before decisions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan, break down or organize a multi-step project or research task, or when work needs 5+ tool calls; after /clear it reads the plan files to restore context.

say_en.note: Keeps results on disk instead of in context

say_en.text: Check whether every phase in the current plan is complete
